dashboard.title: AWS Security Hub - 표준 관제 대시보드 (Standard)
dashboard.description: AWS 공식 블로그(Detect and respond to security threats in near real-time using Amazon Managed Grafana)가 제공하는 참조 대시보드(SecurityHub-v3.json)의 패널 구성을 우리 Security Lake OCSF 'sh_findings' 테이블에 맞게 remap하고, gauge/bargauge/piechart/timeseries 등 그래프 계열 패널로 다시 구성한 버전. sh_findings는 append-only 이벤트 로그라 모든 쿼리가 finding_info.uid별 최신 스냅샷(ROW_NUMBER() OVER PARTITION BY)만 남기고 집계한다. 시계열 패널은 grafana-athena-datasource target에 format:'timeseries'를 쓰고 날짜 컬럼을 'time'으로 alias해야 preferredVisualisationType이 'graph'로 정상 인식된다(format:'table'로 두면 barchart 패널이 No Data로 렌더링되는 문제를 이전에 겪음 - docs/grafana/grafana-soc-dashboard.json Panel2 참고).

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) SELECT count(*) as total_findings FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed')

panels.title: Critical Findings (지금)
panels.description: 현재 활성 Critical 등급 finding 수 - 0보다 크면 빨간 배경.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, severity, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) SELECT count(*) as critical_now FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND severity = 'Critical' AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed')

panels.title: 컴플라이언스 Pass Rate
panels.description: AWS Config 기반 컴플라이언스 체크 중 PASSED 비율.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, compliance.status as compliance_status, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0), cur AS (SELECT compliance_status FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed')) SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN compliance_status = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) as pass_rate FROM cur

panels.title: Total Providers
panels.description: 활성 finding을 만들어낸 서로 다른 보안 제품 수(Security Hub/GuardDuty/Config 등).

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, metadata.product.name as product_name, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) SELECT count(distinct product_name) as total_providers FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed')

panels.title: Findings By Severity
panels.description: 심각도별 활성 finding 분포 (가로 막대 게이지).

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, severity, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) SELECT severity, count(*) as cnt FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed') GROUP BY severity ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: Findings By Compliance Status
panels.description: AWS Config 기반 컴플라이언스 체크 결과 분포 (PASSED/FAILED/WARNING/NOT_AVAILABLE).

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, compliance.status as compliance_status, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) SELECT compliance_status, count(*) as cnt FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed') GROUP BY compliance_status ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: Findings by Type
panels.description: finding_info.types(OCSF 분류 태그, 배열)를 UNNEST해서 집계.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, finding_info.types as types, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0), cur AS (SELECT uid, types FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed')) SELECT t as finding_type, count(*) as cnt FROM cur CROSS JOIN UNNEST(types) as u(t) GROUP BY t ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Findings by Resource Type
panels.description: AWS 리소스 타입별(AwsEc2Instance, AwsIamRole 등) 활성 finding 분포 상위 15개.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, resource.type as resource_type, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) SELECT resource_type, count(*) as cnt FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed') GROUP BY resource_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Findings by Account ID
panels.description: AWS 계정별 활성 finding 건수(현재는 단일 계정 데모라 1행만 나올 수 있음).

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, accountid, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) SELECT accountid, count(*) as cnt FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed') GROUP BY accountid ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: Findings By Provider Over Time
panels.description: 제품(Security Hub/GuardDuty/Config)별 날짜별 활성 finding 건수 추이.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, metadata.product.name as product_name, cast(time_dt as date) as d, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) SELECT d as "time", product_name, count(*) as cnt FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed') GROUP BY d, product_name ORDER BY d

panels.title: Critical Findings Count by Date
panels.description: 날짜별 활성 Critical finding 건수 추이.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, status, cast(time_dt as date) as d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0 WHERE severity = 'Critical') SELECT d as "time", count(*) as critical_cnt FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed') GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

panels.title: Top 10 Recent Critical/High Findings
panels.description: 최근 갱신된 Critical/High 활성 finding 10건 (원본은 Critical만이었으나 데모 계정 특성상 표본이 너무 적어 High까지 포함).

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, finding_info.title as title, severity, status, resource.type as resource_type, time_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0 WHERE severity IN ('High','Critical')) SELECT title, resource_type, severity, time_dt as last_updated FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Resolved','Suppressed') ORDER BY time_dt DESC LIMIT 10
